_provenance: Recorded live from api.uspto.gov/api/v1/petition/decisions on 2026-10-06/07 (UTC) through this repo's FPDClient (POST /search), one request per 10 s, for docs/PETITION-STATISTICS.md. facet_probes: raw request bodies and responses, the record bag emptied (only the facet counts matter). tool_calls: every FPDClient.search_petitions call the three statistics tools made in the live smoke, keyword arguments and the client's return value verbatim (a 404 'No matching records' is the client's error envelope, which the tools read as zero). No keys anywhere: requests carry the key in a header the recorder never saw. requestIdentifier values are upstream's. The stats_corpus_turnaround case keeps only its outcome call; its two 100-row sample pages (offsets 0 and 556,773, which showed that deep offsets work) were dropped for size.
